claim: The sample scan shows a four-file preflight report.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:sample-scan
sandbox: Fresh browser context; click Run sample scan; observe the report finding.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: Dedicated browser context; wait for the worker, set offline, reload, and run the sample scan.

claim: The website demo uses fixed sample records and does not upload visitor files.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:local-demo-privacy
sandbox: Fresh browser context; run the sample, record requests, and assert no cross-origin requests or file input.

claim: The migration set generates printable and downloadable PhotoPrism or Lightroom briefs with saved layouts.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:migration-brief
sandbox: Fresh browser context; mock one valid license result, load the shipped sample report, save a layout, print, and download the brief.
